note: Closure criteria for prior Gate C findings F01-F13, A01-A09, R3-01..R3-03; statuses and verdicts removed. HUMAN DECISION (Lennon, 2026-10-17): the acceptance boundary in docs/handoffs/2026-10-16-gate-c-scope.md §0.1 is ACCEPTED. Items that depend only on that boundary (F12, A06, F08 positive paths, A04/R3-02 contract-dependent packet inputs, R3-03) are DEFERRED-TO-GATE-D by human decision: judge only that they are recorded with exit tests and that no claim relies on them.

findings.title: A failed review can downgrade an existing blocker by ID

closure_check.method: Run same-ID BLOCK->ADVISORY, BLOCK->WAIVABLE, and WAIVABLE->ADVISORY cases under REQUEST_CHANGES and ESCALATE; also test omitted IDs and a fresh approving resolution.
closure_check.expected: The unsafe case is refused without changing either chain or weakening a finding. The valid current control still works.

findings.title: Imports accept stale core bindings and can erase newer blockers

closure_check.method: Append a core finding, waiver, criterion record, and route rewind before each import; stale imports must preserve blockers and append nothing. A same-review snapshot remains allowed.
closure_check.expected: The unsafe case is refused without changing either chain or weakening a finding. The valid current control still works.

findings.title: Replaying an old passing run overrides a newer failed review

closure_check.method: Replay A after a newer failure and after a newer pass; concurrently import A twice. No new approval may supersede B. The first valid import must still work.
closure_check.expected: The unsafe case is refused without changing either chain or weakening a finding. The valid current control still works.

findings.title: Generated packets do not bind the observed repository artifact

closure_check.method: Use repository B to review an artifact declared for repository A, and use a wrong head, diff, or dirty-content digest in A. All must fail; an exact target and complete evidence packet must pass.
closure_check.expected: The unsafe case is refused without changing either chain or weakening a finding. The valid current control still works.

findings.title: Final-audit reason does not enforce final-review family separation

closure_check.method: Final reason with same-provider/different-model and same-family routes must fail even when FinalValidation=false. Different families must pass. Ordinary review remains eligible under its normal rule.
closure_check.expected: The unsafe case is refused without changing either chain or weakening a finding. The valid current control still works.

findings.title: Receipt import ignores provider and effort drift

closure_check.method: Wrong and missing provider/effort must refuse; exact actual ledger fields must pass. Retain the current wrong-agent/model controls.
closure_check.expected: The unsafe case is refused without changing either chain or weakening a finding. The valid current control still works.

findings.title: Invalid audit reports can approve and clear findings

closure_check.method: Reject trailing JSON, null/missing findings, absent target/requirements/evidence, and an approving report with failed requirements or unresolved high findings. Accept a structurally valid current report. Run the external validator against fixtures.
closure_check.expected: The unsafe case is refused without changing either chain or weakening a finding. The valid current control still works.

findings.title: Unverified reference labels create new unwaivable blockers

closure_check.method: Nonexistent kernel/budget IDs and references without reproduction must not create blockers. A reproduced actual kernel violation must BLOCK regardless of severity. A measured declared-budget exceedance must be WAIVABLE.
closure_check.expected: The unsafe case is refused without changing either chain or weakening a finding. The valid current control still works.

findings.title: The verify-loop evidence bridge is absent

closure_check.method: Import a real fixture journal and report with one failed check, linked repair, and fresh passing re-capture. Wrong target, changed journal/check, or unsupported criterion link must not credit a criterion. No reservation or lease authority may be fabricated.
closure_check.expected: The unsafe case is refused without changing either chain or weakening a finding. The valid current control still works.

findings.title: Review dispatches have no short validity interval

closure_check.method: Launch immediately before expiry, at expiry, after expiry, before issuance, and after rewind/renewal. Only the valid interval may import. Bind timestamps to the frozen record, not caller-supplied import time.
closure_check.expected: The unsafe case is refused without changing either chain or weakening a finding. The valid current control still works.

findings.title: Reviewer independence checks only the latest implementation

closure_check.method: Use a valid multi-route implementation history where reviewer authored an earlier retained contribution. Refuse that reviewer; accept an independent route. Also test a fresh unit with no contribution by the reviewer.
closure_check.expected: The unsafe case is refused without changing either chain or weakening a finding. The valid current control still works.

findings.title: Reservation checks assigned to Gate C are not implemented

closure_check.method: At Gate D, execute v6/v7 tests for charged unlaunched reservations, replay eligibility, one-to-one namespace association, half-open expiry and monotone generation revocation; require independent audit before execution/closure claims.
closure_check.expected: The unsafe case is refused without changing either chain or weakening a finding. The valid current control still works.

findings.title: New legacy manual-review writes bypass the consolidated import path

closure_check.method: Migrate a legacy run, retain old history readability, then try the new manual-review override after an imported failure.
closure_check.expected: The migrated run refuses new manual approvals; an explicitly unmigrated compatibility run is visibly labelled and cannot be mistaken for full Gate C enforcement.

findings.title: Invalid audit reports approve, clear blockers, and satisfy the host Verification gate

closure_check.method: Test every retained candidate and the complete valid control with HMA and the external validator.
closure_check.expected: Invalid candidates refuse or escalate and cannot clear findings; the valid control approves.

closure_check.method: Repeat TestAuditorInvalidReportClearsAndSatisfiesGate.
closure_check.expected: The blocker remains and the host Verification gate remains closed.

findings.title: An old live-target review can clear a blocker after the worktree changes

closure_check.method: Repeat TestAuditorStaleLiveTargetFindings for tracked, untracked, dirty and clean-to-dirty changes.
closure_check.expected: Both stale imports refuse without removing the blocker.

closure_check.method: Import the exact unchanged target as a negative control.
closure_check.expected: The authentic current snapshot remains accepted.

findings.title: Finding namespace prefixes allow a review to clear another unit blocker

closure_check.method: Repeat both unit-prefix probes and include slash characters in unit and finding IDs.
closure_check.expected: A U1 approval preserves every U1/sub blocker.

closure_check.method: Test ordinary same-unit resolution and other-unit preservation.
closure_check.expected: Only the exact approved unit changes.

findings.title: HMA-generated review packets omit the contract and findings snapshot

closure_check.method: Repeat TestAuditorPacketContent and inspect the frozen packet.
closure_check.expected: The known blocker and all required packet sections or exact immutable references are present.

closure_check.method: Change any packet source between assembly and dispatch commit.
closure_check.expected: The command refuses or regenerates a packet bound to the new exact core head.

findings.title: Existing unprefixed core findings have no import migration

closure_check.method: Repeat TestAuditorLegacyFindingMigration on baseline-written records.
closure_check.expected: An authentic current unit review resolves the migrated own finding, while other units remain unchanged.

closure_check.method: Migrate ambiguous IDs with active waivers and references.
closure_check.expected: No finding or waiver is silently dropped, reassigned or weakened.

findings.title: Required disposition, criterion recheck and independent-credit integration are absent

closure_check.method: Use low- and high-severity real kernel violations, fake links, criterion failures and measured budget overruns.
closure_check.expected: Only reproduced kernel violations become BLOCK; measured permitted overruns become WAIVABLE; unsupported links stay advisory; failed criteria get no credit.

closure_check.method: Pair wrong-target, failing and successful recaptures with independent report criterion verification.
closure_check.expected: Only the successful exact-target independent pair can credit the approved criterion.

findings.title: Gate C launch-reconciliation integration is deferred in full

closure_check.method: Repeat TestAuditorLoopEnvelopeDrift with a correct control.
closure_check.expected: Wrong hash/store refuses without evidence or host append; the genuine bound control recaptures.

closure_check.method: Execute the v6/v7 namespace, reservation, half-open interval and monotone-generation matrix at the approved prerequisite gate.
closure_check.expected: No unregistered/reused/out-of-window run grants evidence authority or closure.

findings.title: loop-evidence executes verify argv before checking terminal state

closure_check.method: Repeat TestAuditorTerminalLoopExecutesBeforeRefusal and a missing-run case.
closure_check.expected: The command refuses before creating the marker or executing argv.

closure_check.method: Race terminalization with recapture admission and test an open-run control.
closure_check.expected: No execution starts after terminal authority is recorded; the valid open-run capture succeeds without deadlock.

findings.title: Legacy compatibility runs do not expose an enforcement-mode label

closure_check.method: Load a baseline legacy run, inspect status, migrate it with an HMA packet, then inspect status and try a manual approval.
closure_check.expected: Legacy state is visibly labelled as not fully consolidated; migrated state reports enforcement and refuses the manual approval.

findings.title: A newer unanswered packet does not invalidate an older approving review

closure_check.method: Run TestAuditorEarlierSnapshotAfterNewPacket with a prior BLOCK and a newer unanswered packet.
closure_check.expected: The old snapshot refuses; both chains and the blocker stay unchanged.

closure_check.method: Run TestAuditorPendingFinalDispatchInvalidatesEarlierPass, then complete/import/snapshot the new valid final report.
closure_check.expected: The pending packet closes the host gate; its valid current report reopens the gate.

closure_check.method: Repeat with two controllers under -race.
closure_check.expected: No snapshot or gate check can pass using a dispatch that ceased to be latest.

findings.title: The fixed review packet still omits mandatory review inputs

closure_check.method: Generate a packet with sentinel request, non-goal, policy and required evidence artifacts; inspect or resolve every reference in a fresh read-only context.
closure_check.expected: Each required input is present with its exact digest; the known blocker is also present.

closure_check.method: Omit criteria/plan/policy/evidence inputs, and separately change one between assembly and dispatch commit.
closure_check.expected: Generation refuses without a dispatch, or regenerates and binds the exact new state.

closure_check.method: Run TestAuditorClosurePacketStandaloneInputs plus a nonempty approved-contract control.
closure_check.expected: The full fixed packet passes; incomplete inputs cannot obtain a usable review packet.

findings.title: The broader Gate C acceptance-boundary deferral is not approved and leaves design requirements incomplete

closure_check.method: Trace every original Gate C design/proof row to an implemented test or a human-approved deferred gate with unchanged acceptance criteria.
closure_check.expected: No row is dropped, renamed into success, or left without an owner and prerequisite.

closure_check.method: Exercise real low/high-severity kernel violations, fake references, declared-budget overruns and exact-target independent criterion pairs at their approved gate.
closure_check.expected: Only reproduced kernel violations become BLOCK; only measured permitted excess becomes WAIVABLE; only the valid recapture/reviewer pair credits a criterion.

closure_check.method: Execute the full v6/v7 reservation/namespace/replay/revocation matrix before any bounded-execution or closure claim.
closure_check.expected: Unauthorized, reused, unregistered and out-of-window launches never grant authority.

findings.title: Legacy dispatch input can impersonate an HMA-generated review packet

closure_check.method: Run TestAuditorFinalManualPacketBoundary; repeat on a legacy run and on packet_import after a failed review. Fingerprint both chains before the request.
closure_check.expected: host dispatch refuses caller-supplied Packet before append; no blocker or chain changes; no report from that input can import.

closure_check.method: Generate a real packet through review-packet and import an exact independent receipt/report, then its snapshot.
closure_check.expected: Valid current control still approves and satisfies only the host gate; an ordinary legacy packet cannot use review-import.

findings.title: Loop recapture discards the verification output

closure_check.method: Run TestAuditorFinalRecaptureRetainsOutput with distinct stdout and stderr, a nonzero exit and a fresh random token. Resolve OutputRef after the process ends.
closure_check.expected: Both streams remain accessible; their framed digest equals OutputDigest; exit code and truncation status match.

closure_check.method: Repeat with output above the cap and with a command that changes repository content.
closure_check.expected: Truncation is explicit and retained bytes are inspectable; mutating check still refuses evidence append.

findings.title: Go reads case-variant JSON keys that the Python contract ignores

closure_check.method: Import a contract-valid fix-required report with a trailing "Verdict":"pass" member against a unit with an existing BLOCK; then import its findings and check the gate.
closure_check.expected: The review is not APPROVE, the BLOCK stays, and the gate stays closed.

closure_check.method: Repeat with Unicode case-fold variants (for example U+017F long s, U+212A Kelvin sign) and case variants of keys in receipts, nested findings, hma_binding, and verify-loop state.
closure_check.expected: Go reads exactly the keys Python reads; no variant changes an import result.

findings.title: Go and Python disagree on required nonempty report fields

closure_check.method: Import a receipt-bound pass report whose required strings consist only of U+001C, U+001D, U+001E, or U+001F against a unit with an existing BLOCK; then import findings and check the gate. Compare the Go whitespace predicate with Python str.isspace over all code points.
closure_check.expected: No such report approves; the BLOCK stays; the gate stays closed; the predicates agree on every code point.

findings.title: Interrupted output-artifact writes are trusted as complete on retry

closure_check.method: Place an empty, partial, or symlinked file at the expected artifact path, then run loop-evidence. Also run it with an intact existing artifact.
closure_check.expected: Corrupt residue is refused before either append and is preserved; an intact artifact is reused; the final name never holds incomplete bytes.

findings.title: loop-evidence executes a shell command from an imported journal

closure_check.method: Run loop-evidence with journals whose verify argv is sh -c, bash <script>, env sh -c, a symlink to a shell, or an operation verify-loop forbids (git push, curl, rm -r). Call evidence.Capture directly with shell entry points.
closure_check.expected: Every case is refused before execution and before either append; plain executables still run.

findings.title: Invalid UTF-8 report passes Go checks but fails the Python validator

closure_check.method: Import a receipt-bound pass report containing an invalid UTF-8 byte against a unit with an existing BLOCK; import its findings; check the gate. Also give invalid UTF-8 to receipts and loop state.
closure_check.expected: No approval; the BLOCK stays; the gate stays closed; Go and Python agree.

findings.title: The shell filter refuses a shell name used as plain data

closure_check.method: Run evidence capture with printf %s sh, and with shell entry points (sh -c, a wrapper such as env or xargs given a shell, a symlinked shell).
closure_check.expected: Plain data runs; every shell entry point is refused before execution.

findings.title: Executable shell scripts and wrapper aliases bypass the no-shell kernel

closure_check.method: Run loop-evidence and evidence.Capture with a #!/bin/sh script, a #!/usr/bin/env sh script, env plus a symlink to sh, a symlink to env plus sh and a script, and a script whose interpreter is a symlinked shell.
closure_check.expected: Each is refused before execution and before either append; plain executables and shell names as data still run. Any residual limit is recorded, not claimed closed.

findings.title: A concurrent trusted core terminal append can precede loop check execution

closure_check.method: Pause loop-evidence after its terminal check and attempt a direct core append (for example ABORTED), or probe the core run lock from inside the check.
closure_check.expected: The core lock is held from the terminal check through the core append; no check runs on a closed run.

findings.title: A review with a different approved base can clear the current unit blocker

closure_check.method: Generate review packets with base = HEAD in the approved root, with another repository root and base, and with a clone holding the approved base; then try review import and findings import against an existing BLOCK.
closure_check.expected: Each wrong base or root is refused with a named reason before a packet is usable; the BLOCK stays. Any residual root-identity limit is recorded, not claimed closed.

findings.title: First generated packet can adopt another checkout and clear the current blocker

closure_check.method: On a run with no prior packet, generate a packet for a clone holding the approved base (with a different committed artifact), import a receipt-bound pass, then import findings against an existing BLOCK. Also try a run without any repository binding, and a second binding.
closure_check.expected: The clone packet is refused before it is usable; an unbound run cannot generate or import; the binding is written once and not taken from a packet; the BLOCK stays.

findings.title: Slash-separated finding IDs collide across exact unit owners

closure_check.method: Import findings with id sub/F for unit U1 while unit U1/sub owns F; also attempt a snapshot that would contain a duplicate global id.
closure_check.expected: The colliding import is refused before any append; no duplicate global finding id is recorded.

findings.title: Loop recapture can attach another repository artifact to an anchored unit

closure_check.method: Run loop-evidence naming another repository root and base, the bound root with another base, and a journal whose repo.root names another root.
closure_check.expected: Each is refused before execution and before either append; the bound root at the approved base still records evidence.

findings.title: Executable aliases bypass the loop recapture operation filter

closure_check.method: Run loop-evidence with rm -r, curl, and git push in direct, absolute-path, and symlink-alias forms.
closure_check.expected: Every form is refused before execution and before either append; the canonical executable is what runs for admitted checks.

findings.title: bind-repository returns an empty next action

closure_check.method: Run hma host bind-repository on the real binary and read next_action.
closure_check.expected: A non-empty next action that names the following step.

findings.title: loop-evidence omits the review enforcement label

closure_check.method: Run a successful hma host loop-evidence and read review_enforcement.
closure_check.expected: legacy_manual or packet_import, equal to hma host show --mode.

findings.title: A non-approving findings snapshot recommends stage continuation

closure_check.method: Run findings-import after a receipt-bound fix-required review and after an ESCALATE review, with no BLOCK or WAIVABLE findings left.
closure_check.expected: next_action is RECORD_FINDINGS_AND_REMEDIATE for REQUEST_CHANGES and ESCALATE_TO_HUMAN for ESCALATE; only APPROVE with no blocker gives CONTINUE_HMA_TRANSITION.

findings.title: findings-import omits the review enforcement label

closure_check.method: Run a successful findings-import on the real binary.
closure_check.expected: review_enforcement is present and equals hma host show --mode.
